name: +1 Muscle Per Step
desc:
Welcome to +1 Muscle Per Step! 🗿

How to Play:
💪 Every step makes you faster and stronger!
🏃 Dodge obstacles and reach the end to get wins!
⚡ Unlock new dumbbells that give insane speed boosts!
🔥 Rebirth to unlock powerful new perks!

If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game! 👍
